brief.en: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
brief.zh: 比坚果脆弱，但是能隔一段时间回复血量

description.en: Infi-nuts are weaker than Wall-nuts, but they can regain health over time.
description.zh: 全息坚果弱于坚果墙，但是他们能在一段时间后回复血量。

chat.en: As a young nut, he spent way too much time standing between two mirrors and trying to look into infinity.
chat.zh: 作为一颗年轻的坚果，他花了太多时间站在两个平行的镜子之间，尝试看到无数个自己。
